user.title: Solace
user.description: Solace calculates lighting for the whole house from one outdoor lux sensor. Add rooms afterwards.

data_description.lux_sensor: The one illuminance sensor. There are no indoor lux sensors; per-room daylight is estimated.
data_description.dnd_entity: When this is on, Solace treats the house as asleep and switches to night mode.

init.title: Solace settings
init.description: Every value here is live — a change takes effect immediately, not on the next poll.

user.title: Add a room
user.description: Pick the lights and sensors for this room. Light groups appear as single entities.

data.name: Room name
data.diminish_pct: Diminish when the near sub-zone is clear

data_description.diminish_pct: A reduction that stays — never an off. 0 disables it.
data_description.manual_hold_minutes: How long a hand touch holds the room before auto resumes.

lights.title: Per-light adjustments
lights.description: Bias is an offset added to the house, room and zone biases. The clamp is applied last and survives every other stage.
